note.en: Two complete Chinese-language examples published by threerocks (@leo_xiaolei): a 49-second snake fable and a 1-minute-52-second wolf story. Original subtitles, audio and author watermarks are preserved. Creating new videos requires an agent with image generation, Python, FFmpeg and a working narration setup; the bundled VoxCPM2 adapter targets Apple Silicon/MLX. Model and compute costs are separate. OpenAgentSkill has not independently reproduced these results.
note.zh: 两段完整中文样片由 threerocks（@leo_xiaolei）发布：《那条死于愤怒的蛇》约 49 秒，《快乐囚禁你的方式》约 1 分 52 秒。保留原片字幕、声音与作者水印。制作新视频需要具备生图能力的 Agent、Python、FFmpeg 和可用配音环境；内置 VoxCPM2 适配器面向 Apple Silicon / MLX。模型和算力成本另计。本站未独立复现这些结果。
